Overview

Udon Thani is a city in Udon Thani with a population of 350,000. A growing city in northeastern Thailand with a significant expat community, very low living costs, and easy access to Laos and Isaan culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year.
